verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Bitbucket hosts Git repositories that users push commits to: issue keys in commits update Jira, and community users describe Git repos, a Git link, and converting to Git. Read-only SSH deploy keys that attach to multiple repos imply key-based Git access. However, no first-party doc explicitly describes cloning, pulling, or pushing over HTTPS or SSH with standard Git clients. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of HTTPS and SSH clone/push/pull, confirmation that standard Git clients work, and hands-on corroboration of both transports.
